subject: specify separate background color for each table using CSS

messages.author: 85e84f25f31bb3f3
messages.subject: specify separate background color for each table using CSS
parts:
I have a shiny app with multiple tables.  I would like to style them individually but cannot figure out how to identify them separately to apply the css.  For example, I would like the border table of one table red and the second table greeen.  I simple example is attached.  Any help appreciated. 

##ui.R

library(shiny)

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  # Application title
  titlePanel("format table: would like to specify separate background color for each table using CSS"),
  
  # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins 
  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(
      tags$head(includeCSS("Styles.css"))
    ),
    
    # Show a plot of the generated distribution
    mainPanel(
      tableOutput("red"),
      tableOutput("green")
      
       
    )
  )
))

##server.R

##css.shiny-table.spacing-s > thead > tr > th, .shiny-table.spacing-s > tbody > tr > th, .shiny-table.spacing-s > tfoot > tr > th, .shiny-table.spacing-s > thead > tr > td, .shiny-table.spacing-s > tbody > tr > td, .shiny-table.spacing-s > tfoot > tr > td {
    padding-top: 5px;
    padding-bottom: 5px;
    border: 1px solid #a94442;
}
